method: binomial thinning of the count matrix per cell; equivalent to multinomial read downsampling. Fragments/BAMs are not released for GSE276870/276872, so this is NOT fragment-level downsampling and the report says so.
note: ATAC sigma is |c1-c2|/sqrt(2)*1.5 (df=1) and is held fixed across targets, so the attenuation column reflects delta only. RNA sigma is the pooled between-animal SD of the Control and 8-week arms, also held fixed.
